title: ShredWidthEngine - full per-sample orchestration, shared-LP assembly, dry-align, latency-mode buffer repoint + masked crossfade
description:
Implement Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine only. Owns the full deterministic per-sample wet path and holds a MeterTap member (depends on c.2 API).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§3 (signal flow), 4.1 (mono source), 4.6 (channel assembly), 4.8 (dry/wet equal-gain), 4.9 (latency modes/PDC, D4/D5), 7–8, 13
- Public APIs of Source/DSP/PitchShifter, DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, MeterTap
- risk_notes: latency-mode switch repoints pre-allocated buffers (no realloc) + ~10 ms masked crossfade (D5); dry aligned to reported PDC only; delay offsets excluded from latency (D4)

Implement class ShredWidthEngine in Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h + ShredWidthEngine.cpp:
1. Ownership: two PitchShifters (+deltaC and −deltaC), two DelayLineFrac (τ_L, τ_R), one MonoSafetyCrossover (shared LP once), one WidthProcessor, one dry-align delay (integer samples sized for Studio max reported latency 1024), one MeterTap member.
2. prepare(sampleRate, maxBlock) / reset(): allocate/prepare all children for Studio worst case; never allocate in process.
3. Parameter setters (block or sample): setDetuneCents, setDelayMsL/R, setCrossoverHz / setCrossoverCoeffs dirty path, setWidth (0–2 factor or 0–200% mapped), setMix (0–1 wet), setLatencyMode Studio|Live, setMonoSource Sum|Left (hidden D8 default Sum), optional setBypass handled by caller.
4. Per-sample / processBlock path:
   - mono x = 0.5*(L+R) for stereo in, or L for mono in; honor monoSource Sum vs Left
   - +deltaC / −deltaC PitchShifter on x
   - τ_L / τ_R DelayLineFrac on shifted outputs
   - shared LP(x) computed once; HP on each delayed-shifted channel; assemble yL = lp + hpL, yR = lp + hpR
   - WidthProcessor M/S
   - equal-gain dry/wet: dry = original input delayed by getReportedLatencySamples() only (not τ); out = (1−mix)·dry + mix·wet
   - push final out L/R into owned MeterTap (decimated path inside MeterTap)
5. getReportedLatencySamples() returns L/2 for active mode (Studio 1024, Live 256). Delay offsets excluded (D4).
6. Latency-mode change: repoint/relength pre-allocated pitch buffers / active L without realloc (D5); dry-align length follows new L/2; mask discontinuity with ~10 ms internal crossfade (dry/wet-neutral or equal-gain blend of pre/post mode output).
7. RT: no heap/locks/logs outside prepare; O(numSamples) process.

Do not edit PluginProcessor, CMakeLists, or tests. Do not reimplement primitive algorithms inline — compose phase-B classes.
acceptance_criteria: ShredWidthEngine owns two PitchShifters, two DelayLineFracs, one MonoSafetyCrossover, one WidthProcessor, dry-align delay, and MeterTap
Per-sample path implements mono source → ±detune → Haas delays → shared-LP + dual-HP assembly → M/S width → equal-gain dry/wet against PDC-aligned dry
getReportedLatencySamples returns L/2 for Studio (1024) and Live (256) and excludes delay offsets
Latency-mode switch does not reallocate; it repoints/relengths pre-allocated storage and applies a ~10 ms masked crossfade
prepare/process/reset API present; process pushes final L/R into MeterTap; no allocation outside prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: include delay offsets τ_L/τ_R in reported PDC latency

allowed: block process API that loops processSample internally
integer dry-align delay matching reported L/2
internal ~10 ms equal-gain crossfade buffer for mode switches
monoSource Sum default with Left option
forbidden: report τ delays as host latency
